Satellite name ArgoMoon
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 6U
Status Was operational until 2022-11-28 (Photos shared on Twitter on 2022-11-19 but orbit needs confirmation as of 2022-12-24, last signals 2022-11-28, EOM declared on 2023-03-17)
Launched 2022-11-16
NORAD ID ? (Not catalogued?)
Deployer CSD (Canisterized Satellite Dispenser) [Planetary Systems Corporation, Rocket Lab]
Launcher SLS (Space Launch System) (Artemis-1)
Organization Argotec
Institution Company
Entity Commercial
Headquarters Italy
Oneliner

Take several historically significant pictures of the EM-1 mission and it will test some innovative communication systems.
Results

Took images of the Earth and moon after deployment. However, the company said it needed more time than originally planned to commission the spacecraft.

Signals detected; imaged Earth and Moon; safing; received additional DSN passes; no signal since DOY 332 and spacecraft is out of propellant; EOM declared March 17, 2023.
Notes

One of 13 SLS 6U Interplanetary or Lunar CubeSats
